business_problem: Banco BV needed centralized visibility into cloud spending across AWS, Azure and GCP so it could forecast accurately, detect anomalies early and embed financial discipline into everyday cloud operations.
solution_summary: Banco BV adopted IBM Cloudability as the control point for its multicloud FinOps practice. As the bank expanded across Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services, spending became difficult to allocate by team, budget and system, and forecasting lacked a trusted central view. Cloudability provided the shared layer for cost allocation, automated reporting, anomaly detection and optimization recommendations across all three environments. IBM also delivered custom API automations plus enablement programs, workshops and learning paths so the platform would be embedded into day-to-day operations rather than treated as a finance side tool. In the resulting operating model, cloud billing and usage signals are continuously ingested, normalized and segmented for product and budget owners, who can then act on near-real-time spend visibility and optimization advice before small deviations become material cost problems.

solution_components.name: IBM Cloudability
solution_components.role: Aggregates multicloud spend, allocates costs, detects anomalies and produces optimization recommendations for Banco BV.

solution_components.name: IBM Apptio
solution_components.role: Supports the broader FinOps and financial-management capabilities surrounding Cloudability at the bank.

data_flow: Usage and billing data from GCP, Azure and AWS flows into IBM Cloudability, where costs are segmented by team and budget line and then surfaced through automated reports, anomaly detection and optimization recommendations for operational owners.
business_outcome: Banco BV gained near-real-time cloud cost visibility, improved forecast accuracy and avoided a large share of projected cloud spend while maturing its FinOps discipline.
metrics: nearly 30% of projected cloud costs avoided over three years
architecture_clues: Covers GCP, Azure and AWS simultaneously
Uses custom API automations to fit Banco BV workflows
Near-real-time spend data is exposed to teams for daily decisions
evidence_quotes: Banco BV adopted IBM® Cloudability®, a market-leading solution for cloud cost optimization.

The solution’s advanced allocation capabilities enabled granular visibility into spending by team and budget line, while automating reporting, anomaly detection and cost-saving recommendations across all three cloud service providers (CSPs).
Over three years, the bank avoided nearly 30% of projected cloud costs through proactive optimization and early anomaly detection.
